condition.label: axial spondyloarthritis
condition.distinctions: AxSpA includes ankylosing spondylitis; mechanical back pain is not equivalent. Ankylosis,osteoporosis,enthesitis,fracture and surgery are attributes.

scope.population: Adults meeting axSpA criteria,including radiographic/nonradiographic disease; active but selected fit-to-exercise cohorts.
scope.stage: Pilot moderate/high disease activity with stable TNF therapy; advanced fused/fragile spine and postoperative use unresolved.
scope.operativeStatus: Primarily nonoperative exercise research; surgical protocols and postoperative clearance not established.
scope.exclusions: Pilot excluded established CVD,exercise-limiting comorbidity,pregnancy and inability to attend. These exclusions do not establish universal contraindications.
scope.uncertainty: Exercise benefit does not establish unrestricted high-impact/spinal loading or a universal stretch regimen.

sources.design: Single-blind randomized exploratory pilot;28randomized,24per-protocol (10exercise,14control); no formal sample-size calculation or multiplicity adjustment.
sources.population: ASAS axSpA,18–70,BASDAI≥3.5,stable TNF-inhibitor use3months,no regular endurance/strength>1h/week in prior year. No established CVD/limiting comorbidity.
sources.comparator: Treatment as usual, asked not to start exercise; one control initiated TNF therapy.
sources.outcomes: ASDAS mean difference−0.7 (95%CI−1.4 to0.1),crosses null; BASDAI−2.0 (−3.6 to−0.4);BASFI−1.4 (−2.6 to−0.3);VO2peak+3.7 (2.1–5.2). Primary result uncertainty must not be hidden by secondary benefits.
sources.uncertainty: Small per-protocol sample,sex imbalance,no adjustment for many comparisons; no long-term structural outcome.
sources.harms: No adverse events reported among completers; one intervention dropout found training physically challenging/time consuming; one immediate hospitalization withdrawal.
sources.limitations: Not an advanced ankylosis/fracture or postoperative trial; absence of observed flare is not universal safety.

protocol.execution: Treadmill walking/running intervals plus6individualized strength exercises: dumbbell bench/chest press,squat/leg press,dumbbell row,machine biceps/triceps,abdominal bridge.
protocol.supervision: Individual physiotherapist supervision for2sessions/week; HRmax baseline test/pulse monitor.
protocol.stoppingRules: not reported as a numeric pain-stop rule; disease activity,CRP/ESR and adverse events monitored.

sources.design: EULAR evidence/consensus update; searches August2024,26-member task force, four principles and11recommendations.
sources.population: Inflammatory arthritis including RA/SpA and hip/knee OA; condition-specific adaptation still needed.
sources.coInterventions: Usual disease care; behavior change and physical-activity support.
sources.outcomes: Recommends assessment, individualized adaptation, competent delivery and explicit FITT-volume-progression; no single optimal execution.
sources.uncertainty: General PA applicability does not eliminate comorbidity/execution risk. Contraindication-for-PA-per-se wording cannot establish every exercise safe.
sources.harms: Discusses transient soreness versus joint symptoms and limited underlying harms data; not universal safety clearance.
sources.limitations: The24-hour rule is an example used in some studies;48–72hour soreness can occur. Neither is a validated universal stop threshold.

protocol.execution: Individualized aerobic,strength,flexibility and neuromotor activity; not an exact exercise.

protocol.supervision: Competent health professionals; delivery adapted to preferences.
protocol.progression: Lower tolerated starting dose in deconditioned/functionally limited participants and gradual increase.
protocol.stoppingRules: Consider symptomatic activity alternatives; no single validated numeric algorithm.
